reasoning.step1:
1) Determine if document is an invoice:
- Presence of keywords: "Rechnung", "Rechnungsempfänger", "Rechnung:", "Datum:", "Warenwert", "USt", "Gesamtbetrag" — strong invoice indicators.
- No dominant exclusion terms ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", "Servicebericht") present.
-> Classify as invoice and proceed.

2) Locate invoice date:
- "Datum: 28.11.2023" found near header line with Rechnung number.
-> Invoice.Date = "28.11.2023".

3) Locate grand total:
- "Gesamtbetrag EUR 164,38" near bottom of page 1.
-> GrandTotal.Amount = 164.38 (preserve two decimals as in source).

4) Identify VAT / tax details:
- Line shows "USt 20% 27,40" and "Warenwert 136,98".
- Vat.Rate = 20 (extract number without % per rules).
- Net.Amount = 136.98 (Warenwert).
- Vat.Amount = 27.40.

5) Determine Sender VAT ID:
- Two VAT-like IDs present:
  - "Ihre UID Nr.: ATU64131246" appears in recipient/customer block (label suggests "your UID" — customer).
  - On page 2, company info line includes "ATU45414706" alongside company registration lines.
- The sender (Impex GesmbH) VAT is ATU45414706 (page 2 company metadata).
-> Sender.VatId = "ATU45414706".

6) Check for ambiguity and non-inference compliance:
- All extracted values are explicitly present in text; no values are guessed.
- Multiple VAT IDs noted but assignment justified by labels; no further inference used.

7) Fields ready for final extraction:
- GrandTotal.Amount: 164.38
- Invoice.Date: "28.11.2023"
- Sender.VatId: "ATU45414706"
- Vat.Rate: 20
- Net.Amount: 136.98
- Vat.Amount: 27.40
